sources.title: SceneGPT: A Language Model for 3D Scene Understanding
sources.snippet: Abstract Building models that can understand and reason about 3D scenes is dificult owing to the lack of data sources for 3D supervised training and large-scale training regimes. In this work we ask "How can the knowledge in a pre-trained language model be leveraged for 3D scene understanding without any 3D pre-training". sources.title: Scene-LLM: Extending Language Model for - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: This paper introduces Scene-LLM, a 3D-visual-language model that enhances embodied agents' abilities in interactive 3D indoor environments by integrating the reasoning strengths of Large Language Models (LLMs). Scene-LLM adopts a hybrid 3D visual feature representation, that incorporates dense spatial information and supports scene state updates.

sources.title: Structured Generative Models for Scene Understanding
